verdict.rationale: Buzz is a team chat and collaboration platform, so an app directory or marketplace is a fair axis. The evidence never documents one, nor any admin flow for installing prebuilt integrations from one. The Persona Pack spec defines a portable, OPS-compatible bundle format with distribution metadata, but a packaging format is a developer building block, not a browsable directory a team-admin installs from, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a team-admin, I can install prebuilt integrations from an app directory or marketplace
